answer.rationale: Roll out the confirmed shortened onboarding flow: it improved completion and time-to-value while also increasing 30-day retention. Do not answer the competitor with broad promotional pricing; the recovered experiment showed qualified-revenue lift but a 12% retention decline, making it inconsistent with sustainable long-term qualified revenue. Onboarding is not a complete solution to current price-driven churn, but it is the strongest verified sustainable action available today.
